messages:
alex: Starting the partial snapshot + backfill for tenant_shards in the 11:45 PT change window. Pinned migration version v3.2.1. Small schema add (nullable col) + async backfill. ETA ~30m for canary. I will claim the deploybot lease and post progress.

deploy-bot: Lease acquired by @alex for migration-deploy v3.2.1 (expires in 1h). Canary route: canary-3.2.1. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/migration-partial-snapshot — follow step checklist.

maria: Quick check — replica lag currently 2-3s, good to start. Please pin app services to v3.2.1 before staged rollout to avoid schema mismatch. Also watch pension-service for `serialize` errors.

sam: +1. I'll pin services via feature-flag `rollout-pinned-schema` to 100% during the window. Also scaling writes to 80% to reduce lock pressure.

irene: Backfill config: batch_size=500, concurrency=8. If we see tx duration >120s or >1 deadlock/10m, trigger holdpoint. I'll add an alert: `backfill-job-duration > 120s for 5m` -> page SRE.

alex: Kicking off canary on shard-12 now. Command: ```migration_worker --tenant=shard-12 --mode=canary``` Will post progress every 5m. Abort criteria: CPU>80% for 3m OR DB lock_wait > 60s sustained.

deploy-bot: Canary completed on shard-12 — 0 errors, avg 23s/chunk. Promoted canary -> staged. Autorollout paused for manual ack.

maria: Ack from infra side. Observability looks stable: p95 latency unchanged, no errors in traces. Proceed to staged backfill for 10% of tenants.

sam: Kicking staged backfill now. Rolling window start 11:50 PT. Posting progress: `/ops/migration/6598765432`

irene: Note: we saw deadlocks in test at concurrency=12 earlier. We're at 8 in prod, so should be fine — but if >1 deadlock in 10m we rollback. Rollback plan: revert app pin, stop backfill, run the revert job (runbook step 6).

alex: Confirming rollback safety net: if we abort we enable `writes-blocker` feature-flag to stop new writes to the affected path and run drain + revert. Will coordinate with support.

deploy-bot: Staged rollout in progress: 10% tenants processed (5/50). Est. time remaining ~45m. Logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/ops/migration/6598765432

sam: Release notes updated: https://confluence/redwood/releases/3.2.1 — includes DB migration details, canary results, and rollback instructions. I'll notify #all-hands once we're green.

maria: Small ops note — ask support to suppress transient 500s during the backfill unless customer-impacting. I'll share a short support playbook.

irene: Holdpoint: shard-19 backfill showing repeated lock wait >60s. Pausing further shard rollouts. Alex — do you want to abort or reduce concurrency?

alex: Pausing staged rollout. Lowering concurrency 8 -> 4 and only resuming on low-lag shards. Not aborting yet. @deploy-bot please extend lease by 30m.

deploy-bot: Lease extended by @alex for +30m. New expiry in 1h.

sam: Done lowering concurrency. Resuming on shards 20-23. Notifying SRE to watch `db.lock_wait` and `tx.duration`.

maria: SRE alerted and temporary dashboard created: https://console/redwood/dashboards/lock-wait-6598765432

irene: After reducing concurrency shard-19 lock-waits dropped and job resumed. No errors observed in the last 10m.

alex: Keeping the service pinned to v3.2.1 until full backfill completes. Postmortem note: add a preflight to detect shard-level lock hotspots + recommend lower default concurrency. Thanks everyone. :tada:
